pages.text: Nothing. An island of unmade stone in it, four pillars round it, each topped by a nail's head that holds nothing yet. Above the middle, the $(l)Unbegotten$(): the voice the Precursors heard.

pages.title: Its Wounds Unhappen
pages.text: Time has not begun here, so nothing done to it stays: every five seconds it is as whole as it was five seconds before. Unless I hold it in slowed or stopped time, where it cannot rewind.

pages.title: Driving the Nails
pages.text: The $(l)Unmade Nails$() take Time from my blood, 24 drams each. Drive all four and time begins: wounds stay. It lashes those who come close, burns with its gaze (the suit keeps the worst out), sends shreds of itself and, at the end, drags everyone in.
